FN-PW2LRGR-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 129
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 129 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Examiners of
Nursing Home Administrators until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This
bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
